azure.aks.api_server_restricted.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the API is public and `authorizedIPRanges` is empty or effectively unrestricted. This permits unsolicited access attempts against the Kubernetes control plane.
azure.aks.api_server_restricted.pass_when: PASS when the API endpoint is private or has a non-global authorized IP range.
azure.aks.api_server_restricted.fail_when: FAIL when the API is public and `authorizedIPRanges` is empty or effectively unrestricted.

azure.aks.auto_upgrade.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `upgradeChannel` is none or empty. Kubernetes fixes may wait indefinitely for manual upgrade scheduling.
azure.aks.auto_upgrade.pass_when: PASS when a rapid, stable, patch, or node-image channel is configured.
azure.aks.auto_upgrade.fail_when: FAIL when `upgradeChannel` is none or empty.

azure.aks.azure_rbac.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.aadProfile.enableAzureRBAC` is false. Kubernetes permissions may be governed outside Azure role assignments.

azure.aks.defender_monitoring.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.securityProfile.defender.securityMonitoring.enabled` is false. AKS threats may not generate Defender telemetry.
azure.aks.defender_monitoring.pass_when: PASS when Defender monitoring is enabled.

azure.aks.network_policy.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the network dataplane is not Cilium and `networkPolicy` is none or empty. Pod-to-pod traffic lacks a configured network policy engine.
azure.aks.network_policy.pass_when: PASS when the dataplane is Cilium or networkPolicy names azure, calico, or cilium.
azure.aks.network_policy.fail_when: FAIL when the network dataplane is not Cilium and `networkPolicy` is none or empty.

azure.aks.no_local_accounts.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.disableLocalAccounts` is false. Local cluster credentials can bypass centralized Entra identity controls.

azure.aks.private_cluster.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.apiServerAccessProfile.enablePrivateCluster` is false. The Kubernetes API endpoint remains reachable from public networks.

azure.aks.rbac.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enableRBAC` is false. Kubernetes API users can operate without role-based authorization.

azure.app.client_certificates.description: For an App Service app, the evaluator flags FAIL when client certificates are disabled or `clientCertMode` is not Required. Clients can connect without a required certificate.
azure.app.client_certificates.pass_when: PASS when client certificates are enabled and mode is Required.
azure.app.client_certificates.fail_when: FAIL when client certificates are disabled or the recognized client certificate mode is Optional or OptionalInteractiveUser.

azure.app.cors_no_wildcards.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.cors.allowedOrigins` includes `*`. Any website can make browser CORS requests to the app if other protections allow it.
azure.app.cors_no_wildcards.pass_when: PASS when the allowed origin list excludes `*`.

azure.app.ftps_only.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.ftpsState` is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and files in transit.
azure.app.ftps_only.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.

azure.app.http2.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.http20Enabled` is false. The app remains on the older HTTP/1 transport path configured by this control.

azure.app.https_only.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.httpsOnly` is false. Clients can send requests over plaintext HTTP.
azure.app.https_only.pass_when: PASS when HTTPS-only routing is enabled.

azure.app.minimum_tls.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.minTlsVersion` is 1.0 or 1.1. Clients may negotiate a protocol with known weaknesses.
azure.app.minimum_tls.pass_when: PASS when minimum TLS is 1.2 or 1.3.

azure.app.remote_debugging_off.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.remoteDebuggingEnabled` is true. A reachable debugger can reveal process state and secrets.
azure.app.remote_debugging_off.pass_when: PASS when remote debugging is disabled.

azure.app.request_logging.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.httpLoggingEnabled` is false. Requests may leave no record for abuse or incident reconstruction.
azure.app.request_logging.pass_when: PASS when HTTP request logging is enabled.

azure.app.scm_minimum_tls.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.scmMinTlsVersion` is 1.0 or 1.1. Deployment credentials and artifacts can traverse weak TLS.
azure.app.scm_minimum_tls.pass_when: PASS when the deployment endpoint requires TLS 1.2 or 1.3.

azure.claude.acr_geo_replication.fail_when: FAIL when a Premium registry reports zero or one replication entry.

azure.claude.acr_public_network_access_d.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is 'Enabled'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.acr_retention_policy.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.policies.retentionPolicy.status` is 'disabled'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.

azure.claude.acr_trust_policy.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.policies.trustPolicy.status` is 'disabled'. Security defects can remain undetected or unpatched.

azure.claude.container_group_virtual_net.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.subnetIds` is null or contains no subnet ID.

azure.claude.cosmos_public_network_acces.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator passes when publicNetworkAccess is Disabled or SecuredByPerimeter and fails when it is Enabled.

azure.claude.cosmos_virtual_network_filt.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled` is false. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.cosmos_vnet_service_endpoin.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator checks properties.virtualNetworkRules for at least one rule with an id. It does not test whether the service endpoint is effective.

azure.claude.cosmos_vnet_service_endpoin.fail_when: FAIL when the virtual network rules list is empty.

azure.claude.databox_edge_double_encrypt.description: For a databox edge device, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.name` is outside the evaluator’s supported double-encryption SKU list. The selected device model may lack the hardware-backed second encryption layer.

azure.claude.databricks_managed_disk_cmk.description: For a databricks workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when the workspace has no nonempty `managedDisk.keyVaultProperties` object. Workspace managed disks lack a declared customer key reference.

azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg.description: For a databricks workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when either named customer VNet subnet has no associated network security group. Traffic into the Databricks host or container subnet can bypass intended network rules.
azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg.pass_when: PASS when both named customer VNet subnets have NSG references.

azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_v.description: For a Databricks workspace, the evaluator requires a nonempty customVirtualNetworkId.value. It fails when that parameter is empty, null, or omitted from a populated parameters object.
azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_v.pass_when: PASS when properties.parameters.customVirtualNetworkId.value is any nonempty string.
azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_v.fail_when: FAIL when customVirtualNetworkId.value is empty or null, or the parameter is omitted from a populated parameters object.

azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.description: For a subscription, the evaluator independently looks for any contact with role notifications On and any contact with an Alert source whose minimalSeverity is exactly High. The two conditions may be met by different contacts.
azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.pass_when: PASS when a contact has role notifications On and a contact has an Alert source with `minimalSeverity=High`.
azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.fail_when: FAIL when no contact combination has role notifications on and an Alert source at exactly `High` severity.
azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.not_applicable_when: The anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.description: For a security contact, the evaluator flags FAIL when no security contact has notificationsByRole On with Owner in its roles. Owners may miss Defender alerts requiring account-level response.
azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.pass_when: PASS when a contact enables notifications for the Owner role.
azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.fail_when: FAIL when no security contact has notificationsByRole On with Owner in its roles.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_endpoin.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when the named endpoint protection assessment has any `Unhealthy` status. Machines without endpoint protection can run malware without detection.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_endpoin.fail_when: FAIL when the named endpoint protection assessment has any `Unhealthy` status.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when the running container image assessment reports any `Unhealthy` status. Known flaws in deployed container images can remain exploitable.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.pass_when: PASS when the assessment is reported and no applicable image is Unhealthy.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.fail_when: FAIL when the running container image assessment reports any `Unhealthy` status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.not_applicable_when: The assessment is absent or all reported statuses are NotApplicable.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when any of the three named agent, update-check, or missing-update assessments is `Unhealthy`. Missing updates or update telemetry can leave exploitable host flaws in place.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.pass_when: PASS when all three named assessments are present without an Unhealthy status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.fail_when: FAIL when any of the three named agent, update-check, or missing-update assessments is `Unhealthy`.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.not_applicable_when: Any named assessment is not reported for this subscription.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when the named machine vulnerability assessment solution has any `Unhealthy` status. Missing vulnerability tooling can leave machine flaws unknown.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.pass_when: PASS when the named assessment exists without Unhealthy statuses.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.fail_when: FAIL when the named machine vulnerability assessment solution has any `Unhealthy` status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.not_applicable_when: The named assessment is not reported for this subscription.

azure.claude.defender_attack_path_notifi.description: For a Defender security contact, the evaluator examines AttackPath notification sources and passes if any has a minimum risk level of Low, Medium, or High. It fails if no such source exists or all are Critical.
azure.claude.defender_attack_path_notifi.pass_when: PASS when an AttackPath source accepts Low, Medium, or High risk.
azure.claude.defender_attack_path_notifi.fail_when: FAIL when there is no AttackPath source or every AttackPath source requires Critical risk.

azure.claude.defender_contact_has_email.description: For a Defender security contact, the evaluator splits properties.emails on semicolons and requires at least one nonblank entry.
azure.claude.defender_contact_has_email.pass_when: PASS when properties.emails contains at least one nonblank semicolon-delimited entry.
azure.claude.defender_contact_has_email.fail_when: FAIL when properties.emails has no nonblank entry.

azure.claude.defender_container_registry.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `ContainerRegistry` Defender pricing row is `Free`. Registry threats and vulnerabilities may lack Defender coverage.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.fail_when: FAIL when the `ContainerRegistry` Defender pricing row is `Free`.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.not_applicable_when: The `ContainerRegistry` pricing row is absent or marked deprecated.

azure.claude.defender_container_registry.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the Containers plan is Free or its ContainerRegistriesVulnerabilityAssessments extension is not enabled. Vulnerable registry images may not be identified before deployment.

azure.claude.defender_container_registry.not_applicable_when: The Containers plan is absent from the complete pricing inventory.

azure.claude.defender_database_plans_sta.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when any of SqlServers, SqlServerVirtualMachines, OpenSourceRelationalDatabases, or CosmosDbs has `pricingTier=Free`. Database threat alerts may be absent for the free plan.

azure.claude.defender_kubernetes_plan_st.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `KubernetesService` Defender pricing row is `Free`. Cluster threat detection may be unavailable.

azure.claude.entra_user_consent_disabled.description: Checks the Entra default role policy assignments for any recognized, nonempty ManagePermissionGrantsForSelf grant class, case insensitively. azure.claude.entra_user_consent_disabled.fail_when: At least one recognized nonempty self-consent grant is assigned; malformed assignments without a definitive grant are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude.entra_user_consent_not_lega.description: Checks default role self-consent assignments for the exact legacy grant policy, case insensitively. azure.claude.entra_user_consent_not_lega.fail_when: The exact legacy self-consent grant is assigned, even if another custom grant is also present; other custom or malformed grants alone are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude.entra_user_recent_sign_in.pass_when: PASS when the enabled user signed in within 90 days.
azure.claude.entra_user_recent_sign_in.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled user has no recorded sign-in or last signed in more than 90 days before the snapshot.

azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_managed_ide.pass_when: PASS when identity.type includes SystemAssigned or UserAssigned.

azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_private_lin.description: For an eventgrid topic, the evaluator flags FAIL when no approved private endpoint exists while public access is enabled. Event topic publishers can use a public endpoint.

azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when no approved private endpoint exists while public access is enabled.

azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_private_.fail_when: FAIL when a non-Basic Event Hubs namespace has no approved private endpoint.

azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_vnet_rul.description: For an eventhub namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when the namespace has no virtual network rule naming a subnet. The namespace has no subnet-restricted access path.
azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_vnet_rul.pass_when: PASS when a virtual network rule references a subnet.
azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_vnet_rul.fail_when: FAIL when the namespace has no virtual network rule naming a subnet.

azure.claude.fhir_cmk.pass_when: PASS when a nonempty Key Vault key URI is configured.
azure.claude.fhir_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.cosmosDbConfiguration.keyVaultKeyUri` is empty or absent.

azure.claude.frontdoor_waf_policy_linked.description: For a classic Front Door, the evaluator passes when any frontend endpoint has a webApplicationFirewallPolicyLink.id. It fails when no endpoint has such a link; it does not require every endpoint to be linked.
azure.claude.frontdoor_waf_policy_linked.pass_when: PASS when at least one frontend endpoint links a WAF policy ID.
azure.claude.frontdoor_waf_policy_linked.fail_when: FAIL when no frontend endpoint links a WAF policy ID.

azure.claude.hdinsight_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the disk encryption properties name a Key Vault key.
azure.claude.hdinsight_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when no Key Vault URI and key name identify a customer-managed disk key.

azure.claude.hdinsight_encryption_at_hos.pass_when: PASS when host encryption is enabled.

azure.claude.hpc_cache_cmk.pass_when: PASS when both key URL and source vault ID are present.
azure.claude.hpc_cache_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when no nonempty Key Vault key URL and source vault ID are configured.

azure.claude.iam_custom_role_administers.pass_when: PASS when any CustomRole action starts with Microsoft.Authorization/locks/.
azure.claude.iam_custom_role_administers.fail_when: FAIL when no CustomRole action starts with Microsoft.Authorization/locks/.

azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_owner.pass_when: PASS when no guest user holds Owner at the subscription.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_owner.fail_when: FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Owner assignment.

azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_reader.fail_when: FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Reader assignment.

azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_write.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Owner or Contributor assignment. An external identity could modify subscription resources.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_con.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `log_connections` has value 'off'. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_con.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_dis.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `log_disconnections` has value 'off'. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_dis.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_ret.description: For a PostgreSQL flexible server, the evaluator parses logfiles.retention_days as an integer and requires a value greater than 3.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_ret.pass_when: PASS when logfiles.retention_days parses to an integer greater than 3.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_ret.fail_when: FAIL when logfiles.retention_days is an integer of 3 or less.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_azur.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` for both start and end address. Resources in other Azure tenants may be able to try database authentication.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_azur.pass_when: PASS when no rule uses the Azure-services-wide `0.0.0.0` exception.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_azur.fail_when: FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` for both start and end address.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_zero.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`. The database endpoint can be reached from any IPv4 source.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_zero.pass_when: PASS when no firewall rule spans the full IPv4 address space.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_zero.fail_when: FAIL when a firewall rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_secure_.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `require_secure_transport` has value 'off'. Connections can use weaker transport protection.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_secure_.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when any collected daily backup policy retains recovery points for fewer than 30 days. An incident discovered late can outlast the available restore points.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.pass_when: PASS when all applicable daily policies retain recovery points for at least 30 days.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.fail_when: FAIL when any collected daily backup policy retains recovery points for fewer than 30 days.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.not_applicable_when: No applicable backup policy exists in the collected vault inventory.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_has_protecte.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when the vault protects no collected backup items. A backup vault with no protected workload offers no recovery point for those workloads.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_has_protecte.pass_when: PASS when at least one protected item is present.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_has_protecte.fail_when: FAIL when the vault protects no collected backup items.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_managed_iden.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when `identity.type` is None. Backup automation may depend on long-lived credentials instead of managed identity.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_managed_iden.pass_when: PASS when a system- or user-assigned identity is present.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_private_endp.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointStateForBackup` is 'None'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.
For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointStateForSiteRecovery` is 'None'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.search_service_logging_enab.description: For a search service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.search_service_replica_coun.description: For a search service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.replicaCount` is 3 or fewer. Too few replicas reduce availability during node or zone failures.
azure.claude.search_service_replica_coun.pass_when: PASS when the search service has more than 3 replicas.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_local_.description: For an Active Service Bus namespace, the evaluator passes when disableLocalAuth is true and fails when false. Other namespace states are skipped.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_local_.not_applicable_when: The namespace status is not Active.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_loggin.description: For a servicebus namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.description: For an Active Premium Service Bus namespace, evaluates declared public-network restrictions, including default action, IPv4 allow coverage and virtual-network rules; trusted-service bypass and reachability remain separate.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.pass_when: Public network access is Disabled, or Enabled with Deny and bounded nonempty IP or VNet allow rules.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.fail_when: Enabled with Allow, Enabled with Deny and no rules, or IPv4 allow rules collectively covering all IPv4 addresses.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.not_applicable_when: Outside the pinned Active Premium criterion; unknown provider status or incomplete facts are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.description: For a servicebus namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when the namespace has no approved private endpoint connection. Messages have no approved private network route.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.pass_when: PASS when an endpoint connection is Approved.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.fail_when: FAIL when the namespace has no approved private endpoint connection.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.not_applicable_when: The Service Bus namespace is not Premium.

azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.description: For a servicebus namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Premium namespace lacks Key Vault as its encryption key source. Messaging data remains under provider-managed keys.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.pass_when: PASS when the Premium namespace uses a Key Vault key source.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.fail_when: FAIL when a Premium namespace lacks Key Vault as its encryption key source.

azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.description: For a Premium Service Bus namespace, the evaluator requires at least one virtualNetworkRule and a nonempty subnet.id on every rule. Non-Premium namespaces are skipped.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.pass_when: PASS when at least one virtual network rule exists and every rule has a nonempty subnet.id.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.fail_when: FAIL when there are no virtual network rules or any rule lacks a nonempty subnet.id.

azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_encry.description: For a Service Fabric cluster, the evaluator scans all fabricSettings parameter values and passes if any equals EncryptAndSign. It does not restrict the match to a named section or parameter.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_encry.pass_when: PASS when any fabricSettings parameter has value EncryptAndSign.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_encry.fail_when: FAIL when no fabricSettings parameter has value EncryptAndSign.

azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_entra.description: For a service fabric cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the cluster lacks a tenant ID or cluster application ID in azureActiveDirectory. Clients may authenticate through certificates alone instead of central directory policy.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_entra.pass_when: PASS when both Entra identifiers are present.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_entra.fail_when: FAIL when the cluster lacks a tenant ID or cluster application ID in azureActiveDirectory.

azure.claude.signalr_service_no_free_tie.description: For a signalr service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.tier` is `Free`. The free tier has tighter capacity limits that can interrupt real-time delivery.
azure.claude.signalr_service_no_free_tie.pass_when: PASS when the tier is Standard or Premium.

azure.claude.signalr_service_private_lin.description: For a signalr service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.
azure.claude.signalr_service_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent.
azure.claude.signalr_service_private_lin.not_applicable_when: The SignalR service uses the Free tier.

azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.description: For a Standard Azure Spring Apps service, the evaluator requires a nonempty serviceRuntimeSubnetId. Other SKU tiers are skipped.
azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.pass_when: PASS when the service runtime subnet ID is nonempty.
azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.fail_when: FAIL when `networkProfile.serviceRuntimeSubnetId` is empty or absent.
azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.not_applicable_when: The service SKU tier is not Standard.

azure.claude.sql_audit_retention_over_90.description: For a SQL audit setting, the evaluator flags FAIL when auditing is disabled or positive retention is 90 days or less. Audit records may disappear before delayed incident review.
azure.claude.sql_audit_retention_over_90.pass_when: PASS when auditing is enabled and retention is 0 (unlimited) or greater than 90 days.
azure.claude.sql_audit_retention_over_90.fail_when: FAIL when auditing is disabled or positive retention is 90 days or less.

azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.description: For an enabled SQL audit setting with a nonempty storageEndpoint, the evaluator checks retentionDays. Zero means unlimited and passes; values below 90 fail.
azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.pass_when: PASS when retention is 0 (unlimited) or at least 90 days.
azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.fail_when: FAIL when audit retention is positive and below 90 days.
azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.not_applicable_when: Auditing is disabled or no nonempty storageEndpoint is configured.

azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.description: For a sql database ltr policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when weekly, monthly, and yearly retention all equal `PT0S`. Deleted database data may have no long-term restore point.
azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.pass_when: PASS when at least one long-term retention interval is configured.
azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.fail_when: FAIL when weekly, monthly, and yearly retention all equal `PT0S`.
azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.not_applicable_when: The policy belongs to the system master database.

azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.description: For a SQL database, the evaluator flags FAIL when the latest assessment scan reports at least one failed security check. Known database weaknesses remain unresolved.
azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.pass_when: PASS when the latest scan reports zero failed checks.
azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.fail_when: FAIL when the latest assessment scan reports at least one failed security check.
azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.not_applicable_when: The database name is master. With no scans on another database, the evaluator returns MANUAL.

azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_full_range.description: For a SQL firewall rule, the evaluator flags FAIL when the rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`. Any Internet host can reach the SQL endpoint and attempt authentication.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_full_range.pass_when: PASS when it does not span the full IPv4 address space.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_full_range.fail_when: FAIL when the rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`.

azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_internet_or.description: For a SQL firewall rule, the evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` as both start and end address or spans the full IPv4 range. Other Azure tenants or arbitrary Internet hosts can attempt SQL authentication.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_internet_or.pass_when: PASS when neither broad rule is present.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_internet_or.fail_when: FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` as both start and end address or spans the full IPv4 range.

azure.claude.sql_server_entra_admin.description: For an Azure SQL server, the evaluator flags FAIL when no server administrator has `administratorType=ActiveDirectory`. Administration can remain tied to SQL-only credentials.
azure.claude.sql_server_entra_admin.pass_when: PASS when at least one Entra administrator is present.
azure.claude.sql_server_entra_admin.fail_when: FAIL when no server administrator has `administratorType=ActiveDirectory`.

azure.claude.sql_server_minimal_tls_12.description: Checks Azure SQL minimum TLS declaration or the reviewed current provider default; it does not probe negotiated TLS. An explicit-setting policy remains separate.
azure.claude.sql_server_minimal_tls_12.pass_when: Explicit 1.2 or 1.3, or string None observed within the reviewed 2026-10-12 through 2027-10-12 provider-default window.
azure.claude.sql_server_minimal_tls_12.fail_when: Explicit 1.0 or 1.1 is a stale below-1.2 declaration, without proving Azure currently negotiates retired TLS.

azure.claude.sql_server_private_link.description: For an Azure SQL server, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.
azure.claude.sql_server_private_link.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent.

azure.claude.sql_server_vnet_rules.description: For an Azure SQL server, the evaluator flags FAIL when the SQL server has no virtual network rule referencing a subnet. The server has no explicit subnet-level network allowlist.
azure.claude.sql_server_vnet_rules.pass_when: PASS when at least one rule references a subnet.
azure.claude.sql_server_vnet_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the SQL server has no virtual network rule referencing a subnet.

azure.claude.sql_server_vulnerability_as.description: For a SQL vulnerability assessment, the evaluator passes when a classic storageContainerPath is configured or expressVulnerabilityAssessment.state is Enabled. If neither classic nor express facts are collected, it returns MANUAL.
azure.claude.sql_server_vulnerability_as.pass_when: PASS when classic storage-based VA is configured or express VA is Enabled.
azure.claude.sql_server_vulnerability_as.fail_when: FAIL when classic storageContainerPath is absent or empty and collected express vulnerability assessment state is Disabled.

azure.claude.sql_tde_protector_cmk.description: For a sql encryption protector, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.serverKeyType` is 'ServiceManaged'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.sql_va_notify_admins.description: For a sql vulnerability assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.recurringScans.emailSubscriptionAdmins` is false. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.
azure.claude.sql_va_notify_admins.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.sql_va_recurring_scans.description: For a sql vulnerability assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.recurringScans.isEnabled` is false. New database weaknesses may remain undiscovered between manual assessments.
azure.claude.sql_va_recurring_scans.pass_when: PASS when recurring scans are enabled.
azure.claude.sql_va_recurring_scans.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.description: For classic storage-based SQL vulnerability assessment, the evaluator passes when recurringScans.emails contains a nonblank string and fails otherwise; other VA configurations are skipped.
azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.pass_when: PASS when the recipient list contains an email address.
azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.fail_when: FAIL when the vulnerability assessment email recipient list is empty.
azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.description: For classic storage-based SQL vulnerability assessment, the evaluator passes when recurringScans.emailSubscriptionAdmins is true or recurringScans.emails has a nonblank address; it fails only when both are absent or false.
azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.pass_when: PASS when subscription-admin email is enabled or at least one nonblank report email is listed.
azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.fail_when: FAIL when subscription-admin email is false and no nonblank report email is listed.
azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when any reported access key creation time is more than 90 days before the scan. A copied account key can provide durable access to storage data.
azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.pass_when: PASS when every reported key is at most 90 days old.
azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.fail_when: FAIL when any reported access key creation time is more than 90 days before the scan.
azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.not_applicable_when: The account reports no access-key creation times.

azure.claude.storage_account_cmk.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.encryption.keySource` is 'Microsoft.Storage'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.storage_account_geo_redunda.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.name` is a recognized local or zone-only replication SKU. A regional outage can make replicated data unavailable.
azure.claude.storage_account_geo_redunda.pass_when: PASS when the SKU is GRS, RA-GRS, GZRS, or RA-GZRS.
azure.claude.storage_account_geo_redunda.fail_when: FAIL when `sku.name` is a recognized local or zone-only replication SKU.

azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when either blob or container soft delete is disabled or outside 7 through 365 days. Accidental or malicious blob deletion can become permanent too soon.
azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.pass_when: PASS when both policies are enabled with 7 through 365 days of retention.
azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.fail_when: FAIL when either blob or container soft delete is disabled or outside 7 through 365 days.
azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a blob service.

azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.description: For a non-exempt storage account, the evaluator requires classic blob analytics logging for read, write, and delete. Premium StorageV2 and FileStorage accounts are skipped.
azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.pass_when: PASS when all three classic blob logging operations are enabled.
azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.fail_when: FAIL when classic blob logging disables any of read, write, or delete.
azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.not_applicable_when: The account is a Premium StorageV2 or FileStorage account.

azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when blob diagnostic logs lack an enabled StorageRead, StorageWrite, or StorageDelete category. Blob reads or mutations may be absent from audit records.
azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.pass_when: PASS when all three categories are enabled directly or through allLogs.
azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.fail_when: FAIL when blob diagnostic logs lack an enabled StorageRead, StorageWrite, or StorageDelete category.
azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.not_applicable_when: The account is a Premium StorageV2 or FileStorage account.

azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when blob soft delete is disabled. Deleted blobs cannot be restored through the retention policy.
azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.pass_when: PASS when blob soft delete is enabled.
azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.fail_when: FAIL when blob soft delete is disabled.
azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a blob service.

azure.claude.storage_container_no_public.description: For a blob container, the evaluator passes only when properties.publicAccess=None and fails when it is Blob or Container.
azure.claude.storage_container_no_public.fail_when: FAIL when properties.publicAccess is Blob or Container.

azure.claude.storage_encryption_scope_cm.description: For a storage encryption scope, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.source` is 'Microsoft.Storage'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when the file service has shares but share soft delete is off or retention is outside 1 through 365 days. Deleted file shares may be permanently lost before recovery.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.pass_when: PASS when share soft delete is on with retention of 1 through 365 days.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.fail_when: FAIL when the file service has shares but share soft delete is off or retention is outside 1 through 365 days.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a file service or the account has no file shares.

azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when file-share soft delete is disabled. Accidentally deleted shares may have no restore window.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.pass_when: PASS when file-share soft delete is enabled.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.fail_when: FAIL when file-share soft delete is disabled.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a file service.

azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the storage account key expiration policy is absent or is not exactly 90 days. Long-lived account keys can remain valid after exposure or employee departure.
azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.fail_when: FAIL when the storage account key expiration policy is absent or is not exactly 90 days.

azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the storage key expiration policy is absent, zero, or above 90 days. A leaked Shared Key can remain usable for too long.
azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.fail_when: FAIL when the storage key expiration policy is absent, zero, or above 90 days.

azure.claude.storage_private_endpoint_pr.description: For a storage account, the evaluator requires at least one Approved private endpoint connection; other states and an empty connection list fail.
azure.claude.storage_private_endpoint_pr.pass_when: PASS when an approved private endpoint connection exists.
azure.claude.storage_private_endpoint_pr.fail_when: FAIL when no storage private endpoint connection is `Approved`.
